Traffic Incharge shared important information regarding the temporary closure of the railway crossing on Hoshiarpur–Phagwara Road.

Commuters are advised to use alternate routes and cooperate with the police for smooth traffic movement.

data.raw_text: Bengaluru Traffic Advisory: Due to BMRCL Metro work near Marathahalli Bridge under HAL Airport Traffic PS limits, movement of Heavy Goods Vehicles (HGVs) on Varthur Main Road via Marathahalli Bridge will be restricted on May 30, 2026 from 11pm to 6am. Restrictions apply in both directions between HAL and Varthur/Whitefield. Alternative routes via ORR, Ashwathnagar Service Road, Karthiknagar and Kadubeesanahalli Junctions have been suggested @blrcitytraffic
